Sobre nós
A XP Inc. é uma das maiores instituições financeiras independente do Brasil, dona das marcas XP, Rico, Clear, XP Educação, InfoMoney, entre outras. Com mais de 4,6 milhões de clientes ativos e um valor superior a R$ 1,1 trilhão de ativos sob custódia, há 24 anos vem transformando o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas.
Com uma cultura marcante guiada por quatro valores - Sonho Grande, Espírito Empreendedor, Foco no Cliente e Mente Aberta - a XP Inc. está sempre em busca dos melhores talentos que tem ambição de fazer o impossível.
Sobre a Oportunidade
Na XP Inc., acreditamos que nosso time é a chave para o sucesso. Procuramos profissionais apaixonados pelo mercado financeiro, que compartilhem nossos valores: foco no cliente, espírito empreendedor, mente aberta e sonho grande.
Como Investor do time de Estratégia XP , você ficará responsável por trabalhar o asset allocation dos clientes de forma sofisticada, garantindo o enquadramento dos portfólios, de acordo com o suitability de cada cliente. O Investor ocupa a posição de referência técnica para o segmento e, além de garantir a qualidade na alocação dos clientes, atua sendo interface direta com as áreas de negócio da companhia, pensando estrategicamente quais ativos devem ser trabalhados e quais perfis de cliente têm maior propensão para determinada oferta. Geram insumos comerciais para todo o time, através de treinamentos, dados, materiais, etc.
Saiba mais sobre nosso dia a dia no Instagram e no LinkedIn.
Confira nossas avaliações no Glassdoor.
O Que Procuramos
Pré-requisitos Essenciais

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Sólido conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RV, RF, Fundos, Previdência, entre outros);
  • Conhecimento sobre asset alllocation, enquadramento, inteligência de base;
  • Morar no Rio de Janeiro, pois se trata de uma posição no modelo 100% presencial
  • Conhecimentos de macroeconomia e sua conjuntura atual;
  • Experiência atendendo clientes Private ou Alta Renda;
  • Se identificar com a nossa cultura;
Diferenciais
  • CGA ou CFG ou CFP;
Desafios e Impacto
  • Atender os principais clientes da XP, em conjunto com o Banker do cliente;
  • Ser referência técnica sobre produtos, planejamento financeiro e asset allocation no segmento;
  • Identificar as melhores oportunidades de investimentos, garantindo assertividade comercial;
  • Construir e disseminar as melhores práticas de investimentos entre os assessores;
  • Realizar consultoria de investimentos para garantir excelência no atendimento e monitorar os indicadores de qualidade;
  • Atuar no nível tático e estratégico junto as áreas que impactam direta e indiretamente o cliente final.
  • Obs.: a contratação é CLT.
Etapas do Processo
  • Triagem inicial: Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.
  • Testes gerais: Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.
  • Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento: Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.
  • Entrevista com a liderança: Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.
  • Entrevista com Head Comercial: Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação
  • Entrevista focada em cultura: Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.
  • Oferta: Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.
Benefícios:
Saúde e Bem-estar
  • Plano de saúde sem coparticipação (inclusive, para dependentes)
  • Plano odontológico
  • Wellhub (Gympass)

  • Auxílio Creche
Vida Financeira

  • Cartão XP Visa Infinite sem anuidade

Modelo de Trabalho Presencial Flexível
O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função, podendo ser totalmente presencial para frentes de negócio e mais flexível para outras equipes.
Seguimos um modelo com mais frequência presencial, mas sempre guiado por flexibilidade e autonomia com a responsabilidade da nossa cultura empreendedora.

This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat relocation package. Please note only referred candidates will be contacted. All applications MUST be submitted in ENGLISH.

Position Description

We are seeking a Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) Engineer to join its Inspection Technology Unit (ITU) within the Inspection Technical Support Division.

The ITU is responsible for the development and deployment of advanced inspection technologies to ensure asset integrity across upstream and downstream operations. The unit focuses on qualifying and implementing innovative solutions—particularly In-Line Inspection (ILI) systems—to improve pipeline safety, reliability, and cost efficiency.

As a Non-Destructive Testing Engineer, your primary role is to lead the evaluation and implementation of NDT technologies, especially ILI systems, to enhance pipeline integrity strategies.

Duties and Responsibilities

As a successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Evaluate emerging NDT and ILI technologies
  • Provide technical guidance on application, and support their deployment across pipeline operations.
  • Oversee the technical performance of ILI tools in the field
  • Collaborate with vendors to improve data quality and tool capabilities
  • Assist in validating inspection results through field verification and integration with inspection programs.
  • Promote the adoption of advanced inspection methodologies to detect and manage critical pipeline anomalies such as corrosion, cracking, and geometry defects, ensuring alignment with safety, compliance, and operational excellence standards.

As the successful candidate you will have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering. Advance degree is highly desirable.
  • Minimum of 20 years of professional experience in asset inspection and non-destructive testing technologies, including hands-on involvement in inline inspection operations and data interpretation.
  • NDT Level III certification in at least two inspection methods.
  • Ability to apply international codes and standards relevant to inspection operations, such as API, ASME, and AWS.
  • Ability to demonstrate a strong understanding of pipeline inspection principles, including pigging operations, pipeline cleaning, and inline inspection tool validation techniques.
  • Experience identifying and analyzing damage mechanisms detected via inline inspection, such as corrosion, stress corrosion cracking, weld anomalies, dents, and cracks.
  • Familiar with high-resolution inspection technologies used in inline tools, including magnetic flux leakage, ultrasonic testing, and electromagnetic acoustic transducer systems.
  • Capability to analyze inline inspection results and provide technical support for run/rerun decisions, dig verification campaigns, and fitness-for-service assessments.
  • Knowledge of AI and machine learning integration for predictive pipeline integrity assessments is preferred.
  • Proficiency in interpreting inspection data using advanced analytics software.
  • Ability demonstrates strong economic analysis, planning, and budgeting skills to support inspection strategy development and implementation.

Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly. At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development. We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer. With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply. We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

About The Role
As an Information Security Specialist in DNV Energy Systems, you will become part of a dedicated and collaborative team striving for operational excellence and continuous improvement in information security. The role reports directly to the Head of Section Information Security and supports the implementation of robust security practices across our business globally. Our team operates with a strong sense of trust, shared responsibility, and mutual support. We expect each team member to apply their expertise while remaining flexible and ready to support colleagues when circumstances require it. This collaborative approach helps us maintain continuity, resilience, and focus in a dynamic environment.
In this role, you will contribute to strengthening both the information security maturity and culture within DNV Energy Systems by working closely with internal stakeholders, colleagues across other DNV Business Areas, and, when relevant, external partners. Your objective is not only to identify risks and report on compliance but to actively contribute to resolving issues - by either offering direct support or by facilitating connections to ensure effective and timely outcomes. A customer-oriented mindset and strong interpersonal skills are therefore essential.
Your work will span advisory and operational tasks, including security reviews, audits, performance monitoring, and project delivery. You will also present results and insights to both leadership and peers. Most of the work will be conducted virtually, with regular in-person attendance at your local office expected. Flexibility is required to collaborate across time zones, with some international travel required, although limited in line with DNV’s sustainability commitments.
Responsibilities
The successful candidate will be inventive, comfortable working in a quick-turnaround, deadline-driven environment, and adept at managing multiple projects and assignments simultaneously. Responsibilities of the Information Security Specialist will include:

  • Supporting the implementation of global and regional systems and improvement plans and contributing ideas to improve information security performance.
  • Providing competent and professional information security advice on operational risks to all levels.
  • Developing the information security capabilities of the organisation, improving risk awareness and providing specialist support to line management.
  • Information security performance monitoring and reporting, including supporting external audits and undertaking audits as part of our internal audit programme.

By joining DNV you become part of a world-leading company whose purpose is to safeguard life, property, and the environment. You will also be part of a culture where our values “we care, we share, we dare” characterize how we act towards each other, and our customers and perform our work.

As one of the world’s top three credit ratings agencies, Fitch Ratings plays a critical role in global capital markets by providing supplementary credit analysis, ratings, research, and commentary to financial market participants. For over 100 years, Fitch Ratings has been creating value for global markets through its rigorous analysis and deep expertise, which have resulted in a variety of market leading tools, methodologies, indices, research, and analytical products. Fitch Ratings is part of Fitch Group, a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries, which also includes Fitch Solutions. With dual headquarters in London and New York, Fitch Group is owned by Hearst.

Joining Fitch Ratings in LATAM offers the opportunity to work with the most celebrated credit ratings organization in the region, renowned for its excellence and leadership. We boast a track record of over four decades of experience, with more than 2,000 ratings assigned to Latin American banks, corporates, structured finance, sovereigns and other entities. We cover the most relevant capital markets, showing a deep-rooted understanding of the region's unique financial environment. Our team is committed to innovation and collaboration, providing a dynamic environment where you can make a difference.

About the role:

Finance team is looking for you! The primary role is to efficiently support the day-to-day financial tasks with professionalism and under moderate supervision. This involves handling more complex duties that require independent judgment, as well as a solid understanding of company policies, procedures, and the importance of trust, confidentiality, and accuracy. The professional will be responsible for offering support in financial and administrative matters

We’ll Count on You To:

  • Book of journal entries
  • Support audits (internal and external).
  • Meet any local legal and statutory requirements.
  • Reconciling and analysis of financial data. As part of the LATAM Hub, it comprises:
  • Review monthly templates submitted by countries to verify accuracy, etc.
  • Review income tax calculation (quarterly) and related matters such as FIN 48 and 5471 forms (annually).
  • Ensure all countries are following the group policies, guidelines, etc.
  • Provide support to LATAM in any finance or accounting matter.
  • Support on reviewing all Financial Statements.
  • Ensure all SOX requirements are met (including Brazil).

What You Need to Have:

  • +4 years of accountant work experience
  • Knowledge of IFRS
  • Direct and indirect taxes of service companies (calculation, tax returns, etx)
  • Strong attention to detail and a willingness to learn.
  • Thorough knowledge of business Portuguese, including grammar, spelling, and punctuation.
  • Advanced skills in English and Portuguese (both written and spoken). Strong oral and written communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact at all levels of the organization.
  • Good knowledge of MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to work independently with limited supervision.
  • Ability and willingness to learn new tasks and software as required.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with supervisors, coworkers, and business professionals.
  • Dynamic, proactive (contributing ideas to enhance all relevant systems and processes), initiative, contributing well in cross-functional teams, open-minded for changes, accountability
  • Self-organized, committed to meet business needs and timelines, able to work flexibly where required and willing to learn
  • Mature self-awareness, confident to liaise with colleagues at other group entities and outside own department and country as required.

What Would Make You Stand Out:

  • An energetic self-starter and team player who is capable and articulate with good interpersonal skills
  • SAP experience
  • Skill in recognizing and suggesting solutions to problems arising from the group's day-to-day activities.
  • Capability to project a positive and considerate image to external parties and coworkers.
  • Languages requirements: Portuguese (native), English (spoken and written proficiency); knowledge of Spanish is a plus.

Why Fitch?

Shape is seeking a Senior Data & AI Engineering Manager to drive our data and artificial intelligence strategy, building the platforms and teams that power our next-generation industrial solutions. In this pivotal leadership role, you will bring technical vision and expertise, guiding the development and deployment of scalable, secure, and innovative data and AI products aligned with Shapes business goals and product vision.
You will lead talented multidisciplinary teams including data engineers, machine learning engineers, AI specialists, and platform architects fostering a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning. Working closely with key stakeholders across business and product, you will translate needs into cutting-edge solutions that deliver measurable business value.
At Shape, you will play a central role in bringing our data and AI product vision to life, building foundational platforms and teams that drive genuine transformation in the industrial sector. If you are passionate about leading world-class engineering teams, creating disruptive products, and shaping the future through data and AI, we want to hear from you.
Responsibilities

  • Define and execute the overall data and AI strategy, directly supporting the companys industrial product vision and roadmap.
  • Architect and oversee end-to-end development of Shapes data and AI platforms, ensuring scalability, security, and modularity.
  • Lead, mentor, and retain high-performing teams, promoting a culture of innovation, ownership, and technical rigor.
  • Implement and enforce best practices for data governance, quality, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI aligned with industry regulations.
  • Manage budget and resource planning, hiring, and professional development for the data & AI organization.
  • Cultivate strategic partnerships, evaluate third-party technologies, and lead platform evolution, integrating the latest advances in AI/ML, cloud, and data engineering.
  • Champion a data-driven mindset, empowering all functions to leverage AI for informed decision-making.
  • Establish and track KPIs to measure the business impact of data and AI solutions.
  • Oversee the documentation, protection, and management of intellectual property developed by the team.
  • Stay ahead of technology trends, bringing GenAI, cutting-edge automation, and new approaches to Shapes product stack.
Requirements
  • Bachelors or higher degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related STEM field.
  • Solid experience in technical leadership of end-to-end data, AI, and ML projects, including managing multidisciplinary engineering teams.
  • Proven hands-on expertise in Python, software engineering, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), data architecture, and scalable data pipelines.
  • Deep familiarity with AI/ML frameworks and tools (Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, HuggingFace, etc.), MLOps best practices, and platform development.

title: GTE CONTROLE CUSTOS
description:
Join to apply for the GTE CONTROLE CUSTOS role at TechnipFMC

Join to apply for the GTE CONTROLE CUSTOS role at TechnipFMC

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 20,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.
Job Purpose
Project Controller Manager will be responsible for all project financial controls, in Large EPCI projects, using the management tools available at TechnipFMC. He/she will also be responsible for forecast and financial results. It is also expected to enhance the lookahead culture, guarantee the project Financial consistency and alignment with Corporate rules.
Job Description

  • Stablish the Project Budget base on Tender Handover information
  • Support Package Managers on financial analysis such as LOP forecast, etc..
  • Estimates Total Forecasts, Quantity / Costs / Revenues / Currency and Expected Outcomes
  • Prepare project LOP forecast, anticipating possible deviations, supporting mitigation plans and the PCM and Project Director decisions.
  • Responsible for preparation of Project Performance analysis.
  • Responsible for generation of monthly internal Project Management Review (PMR)
  • Responsible for approval standard commitment control and vendor/ subcontractors invoice as per system workflow
  • Manage team up to 10 Project Controllers
  • Support VOR & CSA preparation
  • Responsible for preparation of cash flows on monthly basis
  • Ensure the Cost Accounting Reconciliation
  • Responsible for Project P&L Forecast (Rev/GM by Quarter), working closely with packages/PCM and providers main justifications if needed.
  • Responsible for Project Financial results (Rev/GM Recognition, External Accruals, Schedule C Analysis, Backlog), working closely with packages/PCM and providers main justifications if needed.
  • Responsible for Consolidated Financial Statements (P&L Segmentation) – Multi Entity Projects
  • Preparation of Cash Flow Actuals & Forecast (per entities and currencies), working closely with packages/PCM and providers main justifications if needed.
  • Place & Follow-Up of Project Hedging Operations
  • Responsible to guarantee the Hedge account process on monthly bases
  • SOX Requirements – IFRS15, Contract Analysis, Balance Sheet reviews information, Contract Assets
  • Answer the Internal Controls and external Audits
  • Equalization with REMS
  • Revenue Unification between different Entities
  • Support Project Teams on Financial topics
  • Assistance Tax-related topics (WHT, PIT, Change in Law, etc.)
  • Guarantee the projects financial consistency and alignment with corporate rules Provides expertise and challenges set up and maintenance of the project revenues and costs measurement systems and reporting data
  • Responsible for preparation of close-out reports, with a view towards improving feedback data and estimation tools on future contracts / proposals
You Are Meant For This Job If
  • Master's/ Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting or equivalent
  • Experience in Finance or Financial Controlling and with ERP system
  • Fluent in English
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS especially (IAS 11, IAS 18, IAS 21, IAS 32, IAS 39)
  • Strong knowledge of accounting concepts
  • Ability to work in team as well as independently
Skills
Communication
Project Management

TechnipFMC promotes diversity, equity, and inclusion by ensuring equal opportunities to all ages, races, ethnicities, religions, sexual orientations, gender expressions, disabilities, or all other pluralities. We celebrate who you are and what you bring. Every voice matters and we encourage you to add to our culture.


TechnipFMC respects the rights and dignity of those it works with and promotes adherence to internationally recognized human rights principles for those in its value chain.

description:
Vendedor senior ingredientes para cuidados pessoais e produtos quimicos gerais

Netvagas Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Join to apply for the Vendedor senior ingredientes para cuidados pessoais e produtos quimicos gerais role at Netvagas

Vendedor senior ingredientes para cuidados pessoais e produtos quimicos gerais

Netvagas Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Join to apply for the Vendedor senior ingredientes para cuidados pessoais e produtos quimicos gerais role at Netvagas

Estamos auxiliando uma empresa com vocação à inovação tecnológica e ao pioneirismo no panorama químico industrial brasileiro. Fundada em 2008, instalou a sua unidade fabril no Distrito Industrial de Campo Grande - Rio de Janeiro.
Buscamos um profissional apaixonado pela indústria química e de cuidados pessoais, com um histórico em vendas B2B de ingredientes ou matérias-primas. O candidato ideal será responsável por gerenciar uma carteira de clientes-chave do setor de Personal Care (fabricantes de produtos de higiene, cosméticos, capilares, etc.), identificar novas oportunidades de negócio, fornecer suporte técnico-comercial consultivo e contribuir ativamente para o crescimento da nossa divisão. Esta função exige uma sólida combinação de habilidades comerciais, conhecimento técnico de formulações e uma forte orientação para a construção de relacionamentos de longo prazo.
Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de Carteira de Clientes e Cumprimento de Metas:
    • Gerenciar e desenvolver a carteira de clientes existentes de Personal Care (fabricantes de cosméticos, produtos de higiene, cuidados capilares, etc.).
    • Alcançar e superar consistentemente as cotas de vendas estabelecidas para ingredientes e soluções de Personal Care.
    • Identificar oportunidades de venda cruzada e up-selling dentro da base de clientes atual.
    • Analisar tendências de mercado, concorrência e necessidades dos clientes para adaptar a oferta de produtos e as estratégias de venda.
  • Desenvolvimento de Novos Negócios:
    • Prospecção ativa e qualificação de novos clientes potenciais no segmento de cuidados pessoais.
    • Apresentar de forma eficaz o portfólio de produtos da empresa a clientes potenciais, destacando benefícios e aplicações técnicas.
    • Identificar novas oportunidades de negócio e mercados emergentes dentro do setor de cuidados pessoais. Desenvolver estratégias para a penetração nesses novos mercados ou segmentos.
    • Identificar e atrair novos clientes, expandindo a base de clientes da empresa no segmento de cuidados pessoais.
  • Consultoria Técnico-Comercial:
    • Atuar como um consultor de confiança para os clientes, compreendendo suas necessidades de formulação e aplicação.
    • Fornecer informações detalhadas sobre as propriedades químicas, benefícios e aplicações dos nossos ingredientes.
    • Colaborar estreitamente com as equipes internas de P&D e Suporte Técnico para oferecer soluções personalizadas e resolver desafios técnicos dos clientes.
    • Manter-se atualizado sobre as tendências do mercado de Personal Care, inovações em ingredientes e regulamentações pertinentes.
  • Negociação e Fechamento:
    • Elaborar propostas comerciais competitivas e negociar contratos com clientes, garantindo a rentabilidade e o cumprimento das políticas.
    • Coordenar o processo de pedidos, logística e serviço pós-venda em colaboração com os departamentos correspondentes.
  • Análise e Relatório:
    • Utilizar o sistema CRM para registrar atividades de vendas, gerenciar o pipeline e manter as informações de clientes atualizadas.
    • Analisar dados de vendas, tendências de mercado e atividades da concorrência para identificar oportunidades e ajustar estratégias.
    • Monitorar e analisar o desempenho de vendas, elaborando relatórios regulares sobre os resultados, previsões e desvios.
    • Apresentar à gerência relatórios detalhados sobre o progresso, desafios e oportunidades do mercado de cuidados pessoais.
  • Colaboração:
    • Colaborar com o Gerente de Vendas e a equipe na implementação da estratégia comercial da divisão.
  • Conhecimento do Produto e do Mercado:
    • Manter-se atualizado sobre os produtos da empresa, suas aplicações e benefícios, bem como sobre as últimas tendências e inovações na indústria de cuidados pessoais (ingredientes, formulações, regulamentações).
    • Participar de feiras comerciais, congressos e eventos da indústria para estabelecer contatos e conhecer as últimas novidades.
Requisitos
  • Curso técnico ou superior em Química, Engenharia Química, Farmácia, Cosmetologia ou área científica/técnica relacionada;
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Vendas, Marketing ou em um campo relacionado à indústria química ou de cuidados pessoais é desejável;
  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B, focados na venda de ingredientes ou matérias-primas químicas para a indústria de Personal Care, Cosméticos ou similar;
  • Experiência na construção e manutenção de relacionamentos comerciais com profissionais de P&D, compras e produção em empresas de Personal Care;
  • Sólido conhecimento do mercado de cuidados pessoais e suas tendências (Antitranspirantes, Matéria-prima de cosméticos, higiene, etc);
  • Profundo entendimento dos ingredientes químicos utilizados em formulações de cuidados pessoais (surfactantes, emolientes, conservantes, ativos, etc);
  • Familiaridade com os processos de desenvolvimento de produtos de Personal Care e os desafios associados;
  • Domínio de plataformas CRM;
  • Habilidade com Excel, PowerPoint e Word;
  • Capacidade para criar, analisar dados e gerar relatórios claros e concisos;
  • Capacidade para interpretar dados de mercado e desenvolver estratégias baseadas em informações;
  • Inglês (falado e escrito) avançado (obrigatório);
  • Espanhol (Desejável);
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes a nível nacional para visitar clientes, participar de feiras e reuniões.
Benefícios
  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Vale alimentação

title: Product Director, Feegow (100% remote-friendly within Brazil)
description:
Company Description

Welcome to the good side of tech

You might have heard about us but with a different name: Feegow, Doctoralia or Docplanner. The names are different depending on the country we are located in, but we are all part ofDocplanner Group .

It all started over 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step helping people live longer and healthier lives?

Where does Feegow fit here?

In 2022 Feegow joined the Docplanner Group, a health-tech company. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions and promoting access to top-tier management for physicians seeking to take their practices to the next level, as well as managers in search of a robust solution that covers end-to-end operations. Our ultimate goal is to create a world where everyone can access high-quality healthcare.

Docplanner Group at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 50 million patients trust us every month. 300.000+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 12 years ago.


And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that considering the diversity of human experience makes a better healthcare experience for all. We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we're 100% remote-friendly.
Remote model: you can work 100% from home, but you are also welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro.

Job Description

Feegow is the leading Practice Management System (PMS) in Brazil for individual doctors & large clinics alike, and a highly strategic product for Docplanner Group, as a foundation to conquer the Brazilian market.

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Director of Product for Feegow to lead our product teams, drive innovation, accountability, and play a key role in our product's modernization. This is a remote-friendly role within Brazil, where you’ll foster collaboration between global teams, steer product development, and manage a talented product team. Your expertise in building a data-driven & business minded product culture whilst delivering fast & safe iterations, knowing when to go for PoCs & robust solutions based on the business appetite and product maturity will ensure the continued growth of Feegow and Docplanner Group.

What we expect from this position:

  • Inspire, lead and bring in PMS product vision to all product managers and teams.

  • Understand a complex environment where the teams have not only individual doctors and clinics that should be delighted with their Efficiency platform, whilst bringing them new value propositions like Visibility & Growth, as well as betting on AI as a door opener for exponential value.

  • Define with PMs the product strategy on every team, how it relates to the broader Brazilian strategy & Docplanner Tech & Product strategy.

  • Influence and establish a shared vision with other business areas as Sales, Operations and Marketing. Be a key stakeholder for Individuals and Clinics Business owners.

  • Ensure upcoming product needs and opportunities aligned with your Engineering Director and Country Managers to create a coherent Product & Tech Strategy and Roadmap.

  • Champion a hands-on approach to innovation by using a combination of Data, listening to the market, and “getting out of the building” to get first-hand customer/user insights.

  • Create a culture of decision-making based on insight, analysis and data across the business.

  • Work closely with our Global VP Product, on standardizing the objectives in clear indicators & tasks and bring transparency on ‘the plan’ across the whole company.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years’ work experience as Product Director / GPM (managing and coaching a group of Product Managers)

  • Experience on B2B SaaS scaleups

  • Solid experience in fast high-growth environment, change management, & business growth

  • A proven track record of delivering significant success, scaling and developing high performing digital products that impact business & delight customers

  • Expertise in the end-to-end product development lifecycle, agile and lean software development practices

  • An entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding organizational, communicative and leadership skills

  • Business savvy, holistic business acumen outside of Product Management and ability to assess product market fit

  • Analytical abilities and problem-solving skills

  • Experience in healthcare is a plus not a must

  • Experience in modernizing tech debt whilst delivering product value is a plus

  • Based in Rio de Janeiro is a plus not a must

  • Hands-on: In Docplanner, being a people manager does not mean only managing people, but being able to dive in the details of problems, opportunities & solutions.

Additional Information

Doctoralia’s Benefits

  • Working hours are from Monday to Friday, from 9 am to 6 pm;

  • We havecompensatory time off (Banco de Horas);

  • Food /MarketVoucher ;

  • Medical, Dental, and Group Life Insurance;

  • Pet Plan;

  • iFeel app , for emotional comfort;

  • Gympass for you and up to 3 people!

  • Creditas : Payroll loan services, eligible after 6 months of employment;

  • Stock Options - eligible after 6 months of employment (5 years grace period) -

  • Birthday Day Off;

  • Daycare Assistance;

  • Partnership Club, with discounts ranging from teaching institutions, such as colleges and language learning services;

  • Referral Program offers up to R$600 per person who stays with us for more than 6 months;

  • Leave of Absence/Time-off: in the event of the passing of loved ones, we offer 10 days off; if your pet passes away, we offer 2 days. Got married? 7 days of rest! Did the baby arrive? We offer 30 days for Dads and 6 months for Moms;

Important: Docplanner is an international English-first company. Therefore, please be sure to send your CV in English


We promote and embrace equal opportunities in our hiring process, and also every day at work. When you apply for our roles you receive equal treatment regardless of age, disabilities, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or parental status, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation or any other dimension of human difference. If you require additional support in your recruitment process, we kindly encourage you to let us know. Behind those words you’re reading, there’s a person (hi!) who already helped a candidate by adapting the interviews, and now we’re lucky to have this person with us. So, even if you’ve never asked for it before, may this serve as a sign that, now, you can do so. We can only truly be equal if we adapt to each other.

“We believe all humans, in all their beautiful diversity, should have equal rights, dignity and respect. Period.” Mariusz Gralewski, CEO

title: Staff engineer - Feegow (100% remote friendly in Brazil)
description:
Company Description

Welcome to the good side of tech

You might have heard about us but with a different name: Feegow, Doctoralia or Docplanner. The names are different depending on the country we are located in, but we are all part of Docplanner Group .

It all started over 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step helping people live longer and healthier lives?

Where does Feegow fit here?

In 2022 Feegow joined the Docplanner Group, a health-tech company. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions and promoting access to top-tier management for physicians seeking to take their practices to the next level, as well as managers in search of a robust solution that covers end-to-end operations. Our ultimate goal is to create a world where everyone can access high-quality healthcare.

Docplanner Group at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 50 million patients trust us every month. 300.000+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 12 years ago.


And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that considering the diversity of human experience makes a better healthcare experience for all. We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we're 100% remote-friendly.
Hybrid model (RJ): If you live in RJ and the metropolitan region, you will work a few days in our office in Santo Cristo/RJ and from home (to be aligned with your leadership).
Hybrid model (CWB) : If you live in Curitiba and the metropolitan region, you will work a few days in our office in the center of Curitiba and from home (to be aligned with your leadership).
Remote model: you will work 100% from home, but you will also be welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro.

Job Description

Job Description

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Staff Engineer to co-lead our modernization efforts, drive innovation, and play a key role in our product evolution. Your expertise in cloud technologies, legacy system migrations, and microservices will help modernize our architecture and enhance scalability, ensuring the continued growth of Feegow and Docplanner Group.

Role

As a Staff Engineer in this area, you’ll be fully responsible and accountable for leading impactful and complex cross-group and cross-area technical initiatives, ensuring high-quality solutions with high operational standards. You’ll also actively partner with Engineering Managers and other tech counterparts to shape the direction of our area and the company as a whole. The role reports directly to the Engineering Director.

We are committed to continuous improvement, open feedback, and working efficiently towards our goals. This role provides an opportunity to actively contribute to the technical direction of the area.

Our tech stack at Docplanner Tech includes .Net, PHP, and Vue/React, running on Kubernetes in AWS. While expertise in these technologies isn’t required, this is a very technical and hands-on role, for which strong communication skills and experience influencing technical decisions are also essential to effectively support the teams.

What you will be doing

  • Lead and drive technical initiatives that impact area level directions (~5 teams ).

  • Actively partner with your Engineering Manager / Tech lead counterparts and engineering teams, as well as working closely with the leaders of the area/company to develop an effective technical strategy .

  • Provide accountability for all the technical initiatives led.

  • Act as a point of reference for our Engineering teams.

  • Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and coaching inside the team.

Qualifications

You’re likely a great fit for this role if you:

  • Have a solid technical background related to the whole SDLC principles and practices (Agile/CD, Lean, SRE, DevOps) and can support and unblock engineering teams in complex technical discussions.

  • Legacy software modernization and migration: proven experience in modernizing and migrating legacy systems to modern architectures.

  • Approach software development with a lean, proactive, and positive mindset, balancing impact and long-term sustainable development, with a strong accountability for delivering high-quality solutions.

  • Have a strong experience in backend development with a holistic understanding of full-stack systems.

  • Experience in cross-team initiative and creating buy-in for technical initiatives.

  • Believe in continuous learning and improvement.

  • Have experience not only designing/implementing/delivering high-quality and impactful solutions, but also guiding and mentoring less experienced engineers .

Also Relevant for the role:

  • Domain Driven Design.

  • Expertise in AWS to help shaping our cloud infrastructure.

  • Ability to oversee database optimizations (MySQL) for scalable solutions.

  • Cloud-native architectures using microservices and serverless along with interaction styles, as synchronous and asynchronous communication, data streaming, and API technologies and lifecycle management.

  • Advanced English skills: comfortable communicating in written and verbal English across global teams.

  • Previous experience in consulting is a plus.

Important: Docplanner is an international English-first company. Therefore, please be sure to send your CV in English

Additional Information

Doctoralia’s Benefits

  • Working hours are from Monday to Friday, from 9 am to 6 pm;

  • We have compensatory time off (Banco de Horas);

  • Food /Market Voucher ;

  • Medical, Dental, and Group Life Insurance;

  • Pet Plan;

  • iFeel app , for emotional comfort;

  • Gympass for you and up to 3 people!

  • Creditas : Payroll loan services, eligible after 6 months of employment;

  • Stock Options - eligible after 6 months of employment (5 years grace period) -

  • Birthday Day Off;

  • Daycare Assistance;

  • Partnership Club, with discounts ranging from teaching institutions, such as colleges and language learning services;

  • Referral Program offers up to R$600 per person who stays with us for more than 6 months;

  • Leave of Absence/Time-off: in the event of the passing of loved ones, we offer 10 days off; if your pet passes away, we offer 2 days. Got married? 7 days of rest! Did the baby arrive? We offer 30 days for Dads and 6 months for Moms;

Other information

Workplace Location:

  • Hybrid model (RJ): If you live in RJ and the metropolitan region, you will work a few days in our office in Santo Cristo/RJ and from home (to be aligned with your leadership).

  • Hybrid model (CWB): If you live in Curitiba and the metropolitan region, you will work a few days in our office in the center of Curitiba and from home (to be aligned with your leadership).

  • Remote model: you will work 100% from home, but you will also be welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro.

  • We provide feedback at all stages

title: Project Delivery Assistant (Remote)
description:
Company Description

Due to our continued growth, we are hiring for a Project Delivery Assistant with M3 Global Research

Job Description

The Project Delivery Assistant is responsible for strategizing custom recruiting actions for Quant and Qual projects, assigning recruiting tasks, and monitoring recruiting activities to ensure projects are delivered accurately within deadlines. The Project Delivery Assistant works across project teams to understand recruiting needs of assigned projects and execute strategy to ensure sample is achieved in accordance with the client’s expectations and established company profit targets. Project Delivery Assistant may execute custom recruitment actions directly, assign tasks to colleagues, and work with managers on larger recruiting initiatives.

  • Manage custom recruitment for 25 or more live projects including complex projects, and challenging recruiting targets, expanding knowledge and experience on market research recruitment for quantitative and qualitative studies.
  • Attending Internal Kick-off (IKO) meetings when necessary to discuss and outline recruiting plans and timelines for successful execution of projects.
  • Create a custom recruiting strategy on projects assigned, initiate and/or execute tasks as outlined, monitoring progress, and adjusting recruiting strategy to ensure the maximum internal sample is achieved to meet client needs and maintain profit targets.
  • Recommend alternative internal sampling strategies to maximize internal completes.
  • Communicate recruitment updates, status, and issues to internal project teams through email, meetings or as agreed in regular intervals.
  • Proactively seek alternative sample and recruiting strategies, providing ideas to improve response rate and reduce costs in each project.
  • Have an excellent understanding of the M3 sampling, emailing, and reporting tools to ensure they are used to the best of their capabilities in supporting project deliverability.
  • Provide constructive feedback to the line manager and assist in bringing ideas on areas where M3 sampling, emailing, and reporting tools can be improved in their functionality.
  • Ensure that KPIs including but not limited outsource rates, panel recruitment and quality scores are achieved monthly.
  • Assist the team in developing custom recruitment strategies to grow membership of the M3 Global Research panel.
Qualifications
  • 1 year of experience in Market Research, preferably in recruiting, sampling or fieldwork.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated knowledge of English grammar rules.
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills (Advanced/ Intermediate Excel) and quick learner of new technologies/software.
  • Exhibit strong critical thinking skills and take initiative to improve skills and troubleshoot proactively using all available resources to support project success.
  • Ability to work autonomously and in a team environment to successfully meet study specific and departmental objectives.
  • Self-motivated and able to (re)prioritize tasks throughout the workday.
  • Exceptional time management, organizational skills, attention to detail and ability to multitask.
  • Comfortable with change, ability to derive opportunity from uncertainty.
  • Fluent in English
Additional Information

About M3USA

M3 USA is at the forefront of healthcare innovation, offering digital solutions across healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals and more. Since our inception in 2000, we’ve seen remarkable growth, fueled by our mission to utilize the internet for a healthier world and more efficient healthcare systems. Our success is anchored in our trusted digital platforms that engage physician communities globally, facilitating impactful medical education, precise job placement and insightful market research. M3 USA prides itself on a dynamic and innovative work environment where every team member contributes to global health advancements. Embrace the chance to drive change with M3 USA.

*M3 reserves the right to change this job description to meet the business needs of the organization

title: Assistente de Planejamento e Controle de Recursos e Materiais de O&G
description:
Job description

O profissional irá apoiar as atividades de suporte técnico aos serviços de planejamento e controle de recursos e materiais.



Main responsibilities

  • Elaboração dos fluxos fiscais e tributários de acordo com as características de cada Projeto, interagindo com a área Tributária;
  • Realização de cadastro de materiais e consulta ao estoque no sistema SAP;
  • Monitoramento da entrada e saída de materiais e equipamentos do estoque dos Projetos no sistema SAP;
  • Suporte ao processo de inventário corporativo e processos de inventários parciais dos Projetos;
  • Acompanhamento do recebimento físico de materiais e as inspeções de recebimento;
  • Preparação de apresentações gerenciais e relatórios;
  • Análise do BAM (Boletim de Aplicação de Material) dos Projetos;
  • Solicitação de emissão de notas fiscais ao Tributário para movimentação de materiais e equipamentos dos Projetos;
  • Monitoramento dos materiais em poder de terceiros (MPT);
  • Monitoramento dos processos de aquisição de bens dos Projetos, realizados pelas áreas corporativas;
  • Elaboração e monitoramento de mapas de suprimentos e de planilhas de materiais e equipamentos dos Projetos;
  • Elaboração do plano de suprimento do Projeto;
  • Realizar reserva de materiais no sistema SAP;
  • Efetuar agrupamento de requisições de compra e diligenciamento dos pedidos emitidos aos fornecedores e subfornecedores (pela contratada);
  • Verificar a possibilidade de beneficiamento tributário de materiais adquiridos;
  • Verificar e criticar procedimentos de armazenagem, identificação, organização, recebimento, transporte, içamento e manuseio de materiais da contratada;
  • Diligenciar todas as etapas dos bens e informar em caso de desvio, a justificativa;
  • Prever os riscos associados às aquisições, elaborando os planos de tratamento para as situações de riscos identificadas;
  • Realizar controle dos bens do Projeto pelo número de série, seguindo a orientação corporativa da PETROBRAS e do plano do Projeto para esses materiais.
  • Suporte em processos de compra e venda de materiais entre a Petrobras e consórcios. u) no processo de alocação de materiais;
  • Suporte no processo de contratação de materiais, mantendo o controle atualizado do Plano de Contratação;
  • Suporte nos esclarecimentos à demandas corporativas referentes ao tema, consolidando as respostas a serem encaminhadas;
  • Suporte no processo de desembaraço aduaneiro dos materiais da carteira de projetos.


Requirements and skills

Formação:

  • Nível Técnico Superior;
  • Experiência comprovada em empresa de Engenharia ou de Logística/Suprimentos.

Conhecimentos necessários:

  • Conhecimento sólido em Pacote Office e domínio em Excel avançado;
  • Domínio ERP SAP R/3, SAP S/4 HANA (módulo MM);
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Logística/suprimentos e emissão de Notas Fiscais.


Additional information

Outros benefícios:

PROGRAMAS DE DESENVOLVIMENTO

Um dos pontos fortes de ser Biper é que ousamos em pensar como empreendedores e moldamos nosso futuro com nossa capacidade de pensar minuciosamente e agir com três passos à frente, pavimentando o caminho para o futuro que nossos clientes querem viver.

E para isso, precisamos estar constantemente aprendendo e reaprendendo, somos #LifeLongLearning.

Na BIP temos programas consolidados a nível Global e nacional para que você tenha uma jornada de desenvolvimento, crescimento e liberdade para você conquistar o que sonha. Aqui você é o protagonista da sua carreira!

Vamos juntos nessa? Confere os principais programas que a BIP pode te oferecer para você chegar aonde deseja:

  • Cultura de Feedback e 1:1 recorrentes com sua liderança e time;
  • Acompanhamento de um Plano de Desenvolvimento personalizado pra você e com seus objetivos;
  • Darwin - Programa global de formação de jovens talentos, para desenvolver soft e hard skills;
  • Grounding –Um programa Global de formação para os profissionais recém contratados em todo o mundo que estão no começo da carreira de consultoria;
  • Induction - Onboarding Internacional conduzido por Heads de RH e negócio para os novos entrantes da Bip de todos os países para promover nossa cultura,valores, proposito e apresentar nossos programas de iniciativa Global.

Nossoportunidade

Estamos à procura de Desenvolvedor/Desenvolvedora PegaSystems . Se você é uma pessoa talentosa e apaixonada por tecnologia que procura uma função híbrida dinâmica, então somos o lugar para você.

  • Nossa oportunidade é híbrida, com jornada de trabalho flexível (40 horas semanais) e o modelo de contratação é CLT.

Atividades:

  • Criar e customizar aplicações em Pegasystems;
  • Projetar e implementar fluxos de trabalho automatizados;
  • Integrar a plataforma Pega com outros sistemas e serviços;
  • Atuar em parceria com o cliente e áreas de negócio.

Perfil buscado:

  • Experiência anterior com desenvolvimento Pegasystems.

NossoCompromisso

Por meio de uma força de trabalho diversificada que representa nossa sociedade, promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, construindo um lugar onde nossos talentos são acompanhados por líderes transformacionais e equipes altamente engajadas. Através do SejaVocê@Capgemini, expressamos nosso compromisso em compreender continuamente as características e interesses que tornam cada uma das nossas pessoas únicas. Orgulhamo-nos da nossa diversidade e estamos empenhados em promover um ambiente inclusivo e com oportunidades igualitárias. Nossas vagas são para todas as pessoas, independentemente de cor, etnia, religião, idade, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual ou deficiência.

Somos reconhecidos pela GPTW como um ótimo lugar para trabalhar e uma das 10 melhores empresas para mulheres trabalharem no Brasil. Nosso compromisso com a equidade de gênero também foi reconhecido pela Bloomberg pelo segundo ano consecutivo, e somos certificados pela Edge e Edge Plus, focadas em equidade de gênero. Além disso, estamos no 11º ano consecutivo pelo Instituto Ethisphere como uma das Empresas Mais Éticas do Mundo.

Aqui, você pode ser quem você é: protagonista do seu desenvolvimento, com oportunidades de aprendizagem, crescimento e atuação em projetos desafiadores.

Também nos preocupamos em oferecer um pacote de remuneração e benefícios competitivos no segmento, reconhecendo competências, performance individual e de equipe, voltados para seu bem-estar físico, emocional, financeiro e familiar.

  • Pacote de benefícios: assistência médica, telemedicina Einstein Conecta, plano odontológico, convênio farmácia, acesso a plataformas de saúde física e mental (Gympass e Equilibrium), vale-refeição, seguro de vida, previdência privada, auxílio home office, empréstimo consignado, plano de participação acionária, clube de benefícios e muito mais!

  • Plano de carreira que incentiva sua jornada e desenvolvimento, proporcionando visibilidade clara sobre as oportunidades de crescimento e requisitos necessários para seu próximo nível.

  • Universidade corporativa e Learning Hub: construa sua trilha de desenvolvimento com formação dinâmica e acelerada. Acesso gratuito a cursos de parceiros de alto nível para aprimorar suas habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, como Harvard Manage Mentor, Coursera, Udemy e Pluralsight.

  • Acesso a certificações oficiais com nossos parceiros, incluindo: AI Breakthrough Award, AWS, Avasant, CDP “A” list, Ecovadis, Everest, Ethisphere, Gartner, IDC Google, Microsoft, SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, entre outros.

  • Através da EF Education First (English Live Brasil), acesso a plataforma online com aulas adaptadas ao seu nível para desenvolver idiomas como Inglês, Espanhol, Francês e Alemão.

Sobre a Capgemini

A Capgemini é líder global em parceria com empresas para transformar e gerenciar negócios, aproveitando o poder da tecnologia, desde estratégia e design até operações, alimentadas pelo mundo inovador da nuvem, dados, IA, conectividade, software, engenharia digital e plataformas.

Contamos com mais de 360.000 profissionais em mais de 50 países. Em 2023, o grupo reportou receitas globais de €22,5 bilhões.

Somos guiados pelo propósito de liberar a energia humana por meio da tecnologia para um futuro inclusivo e sustentável, e por nossos sete valores: honestidade, audácia, confiança, liberdade, espírito de equipe, modéstia e diversão. Se você compartilha desses valores, aqui é o seu lugar!

Trabalhar conosco significa estar em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, cercado por uma equipe engajada e focada em resultados.

Acreditamos que a diversidade é a nossa força! Ela nos ajuda a superar desafios, inovar e crescer juntos. Pensamos de forma diferente e estamos sempre em busca das melhores soluções para oferecer uma experiência inesquecível aos nossos clientes.

Todos são muito bem-vindos!

Que tal fazer parte de uma equipe em uma empresa grande, com mais de 9.000 colaboradores espalhados pelo país?

Atuamos nos setores de Call Center, PDV e Comercial. Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho jovem, motivador e cheio de oportunidades para aprender e crescer. Contamos com uma infraestrutura moderna, benefícios e remuneração que valorizam o seu talento.

MÉDICO CIRURGIÃO VASCULAR - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II

Join to apply for the MÉDICO CIRURGIÃO VASCULAR role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde .

Since December 2015, SPDM/PAIS has been responsible, in partnership with the Municipal Health Department of Rio de Janeiro, for managing the Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

The hospital infrastructure includes ten floors with emergency services, adult, pediatric, and neonatal Intensive Care Units (ICUs), maternity, medical, general surgery, maxillofacial surgery, neurosurgery, psychiatry, pediatrics, and orthopedics. Imaging exams (X-ray, CT, ultrasound, ECG, echocardiography) and laboratory tests are also performed.

Given the large elderly population in the West Zone served by the hospital, there are two wards dedicated to this demographic. The Burn Treatment Center offers a specialized ICU to prevent infections, which can be severe for burn patients. Additionally, the hospital includes the Regional Emergency Coordination (CER) Santa Cruz, with 39 beds, aimed at handling less complex cases to free up the main hospital for urgent, high-risk, or surgical cases. A unique feature of this CER is its specialized care in Psychiatry and Obstetrics.

Responsibilities and duties

Provide care in the wards, surgical center, and ICU of the Hospital Municipal Pedro II.

Requirements and qualifications

  • Complete Medical Degree
  • Residency or Specialist Title in the area
  • Active registration with the professional council
  • RQE in Vascular Surgery
  • Minimum of 6 months proven experience in the role

Additional information

The hospital is located in Santa Cruz - RJ.

Workload options include 12h, 10h, or 24h weekly shifts.

Professionals from partner companies, suppliers, or service providers, or those with familial or other contractual links with the service, should consult current HR regulations through the Recruitment and Selection department.

Join Our Team

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.

We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.

About the Role

We are seeking aStaff-level DevOps Engineer to take a strategic and hands-on role in assessing and improving infrastructure within a cloud-based investment management environment. This is more than just an execution-focused role — it requires a strong architectural mindset, an ability to guide best practices, and a passion for elevating DevOps standards across the organization.

In this role, you will work closely with the development team to assess the current DevOps landscape and help design a clear, scalable roadmap. The focus will be on automating DB schema updates, enhancing database backup strategies, improving logging and monitoring systems, and reviewing the current usage of AWS services (including S3).


Key Responsibilities:
  • Audit and assess the current DevOps environment to identify areas for improvement.
  • Design and drive the implementation of scalable and automated DevOps practices.
  • Enhance and automate database schema updating and backup strategies.
  • Improve observability through centralized logging and monitoring.
  • Provide AWS architectural reviews and improve technical documentation.
  • Coach the dev team on DevOps best practices and build internal capability.
Must-Have:
  • 5+ years of experience in senior or staff-level DevOps roles.
  • Proven ability to evaluate infrastructure and design robust DevOps strategies.
  • Hands-on experience withAWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK) .
  • Strong familiarity with AWS architecture and documentation standards.
  • Availability to worknoon to 4/5 pm ET .
Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience withMobile Device Management (MDM) tools.

Este profissional atua em apoio aos eletricistas e engenheiros, realizando atividades básicas de manutenção e reparo em conformidade com as normas técnicas e de segurança. Ler e interpretar esquemas elétricos, diagramas e projetos para auxiliar na execução de instalações e manutenções de acordo com as especificações. Manter o ambiente de trabalho organizado e seguro, utilizando equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs) adequados e seguindo as normas de segurança estabelecidas. Colaborar com a equipe de manutenção, seguindo instruções e orientações dos eletricistas e engenheiros para a execução eficiente das tarefas. Auxiliar na realização de testes e medições elétricas, utilizando instrumentos apropriados para verificar a eficiência e segurança dos sistemas elétricos. Participar do inventário e controle de materiais e ferramentas elétricas, garantindo o armazenamento e uso adequado dos mesmos. Relatar qualquer problema ou situação anômala observada durante as atividades aos profissionais responsáveis para a tomada de medidas corretivas. Requisitos:Ensino fundamental completo. Habilidade para utilizar ferramentas e instrumentos de medição elétrica de forma segura e eficiente. Conhecimento das normas técnicas e de segurança aplicáveis às instalações e manutenções elétricas.

inspecionar periodicamente e manter as instalações de climatização nas dependências do cliente conforme padrões, procedimentos e instruções estabelecidos e vigentes por normativa técnica pertinente;

title: Responsável Tributário Nacional (Tax Manager)
description:
Responsável Tributário Nacional (Tax Manager)

- - - - - - - - - - - -

A Michelin, líder do segmento de pneus, se dedica ao desenvolvimento da mobilidade de seus clientes, de forma sustentável, criando e distribuindo os pneus, serviços e soluções mais adequados às suas necessidades, fornecendo serviços digitais, mapas e guias, para ajudá-los a tornar suas viagens experiências únicas; e desenvolvendo materiais de alta tecnologia, que atendem à indústria da mobilidade.

Defendemos nossos valores de respeito aos clientes, às pessoas, aos acionistas, ao meio ambiente e aos fatos em todos os lugares onde estamos presentes.

Nós nos importamos em dar as pessoas uma melhor maneira de seguir em frente.

Seja parte de um time no qual você é empoderado e encorajado a alcançar o seu potencial ao máximo e a realizar as suas ambições.

Ao redor do mundo, através da diversidade, ajude a criar o futuro da Michelin com paixão, entusiasmo e orgulho.

Com a mesma atenção aos nossos colaboradores e clientes, nós inovamos além e melhor pela sustentabilidade.

Valorizamos as singularidades de cada um e consideramos a diversidade como um valor, por isso reforçamos este convite para você, que se autodeclara negro ou negra, do gênero feminino ou masculino, LGBTQIA+, pessoa com deficiência ou acima de 50 anos.

Venha desenvolver sua carreira no Grupo Michelin e participe do nosso processo!

Prefira a Michelin para crescer!

Sobre a posição:

Estamos buscando um Gerente Tributário para integrar nossa equipe tributária e liderar iniciativas tributárias estratégicas em nossas operações. Esta posição é ideal para um profissional dinâmico com ampla experiência em planejamento tributário, parcerias comerciais e modelos de negócios digitais.

Como Gerente Tributário Nacional, você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com equipes multifuncionais para fornecer ativamente consultoria estratégica a líderes empresariais, orientando-os sobre a estrutura tributária de diversas iniciativas. Você gerenciará riscos tributários, identificará oportunidades de otimização e apoiará o crescimento dos negócios em um ambiente regulatório e digital em rápida evolução. Além disso, você será responsável pelo contencioso tributário no Brasil, coordenando e gerenciando escritórios de advocacia externos.

Responsabilidades e deveres:

Governança Tributária e Gestão de Riscos:

· Identificar e gerenciar riscos para garantir que as contingências fiscais sejam devidamente relatadas e documentadas, em conformidade com as políticas do Grupo Michelin.

· Manter bom relacionamento com o fisco, promovendo a participação em programas de conformidade tributária.

· Desenvolver e manter estruturas sólidas de governança tributária.

Contencioso Tributário:

· Definir a estratégia a ser adotada nas defesas administrativas e judiciais, considerando a interpretação da legislação, jurisprudência e peculiaridades empresariais.

· Gerenciar a carteira tributária administrativa e judicial das empresas Michelin no Brasil.

· Revisar periodicamente a previsão de sucesso do portfólio de processos, garantindo que as provisões realizadas sejam suficientes e adequadas.

· Identificar oportunidades de ajuizamento de medidas judiciais ativas visando à recuperação de créditos tributários.

Reforma Tributária:

· Liderar análises estratégicas da reforma tributária, interagindo com diversas áreas de negócios para garantir a conformidade fiscal das empresas do Grupo.

· Avaliar os impactos e oportunidades decorrentes das mudanças, visando otimizar a carga tributária, alavancar créditos tributários e adequar o modelo de negócios.

Planejamento e Consultoria Tributária:

· Desenvolver iniciativas de planejamento tributário e recuperação de créditos tributários.

· Projetar, dar suporte e implementar estratégias fiscais alinhadas aos objetivos e princípios comerciais do Grupo Michelin.

· Responsável pela Zona Franca de Manaus

Pré-requisitos

Educação:

· Bacharel em Direito, devidamente inscrito na Ordem dos Advogados (OAB).

· Pós-graduação ou Mestrado em Direito Tributário/Planejamento Tributário.

Experiência:

· Sólida Experiência na área tributária comprovada em empresas de grande porte ou auditorias.

Idiomas:

· Inglês avançado (C1)

· Francês e espanhol serão considerados como diferenciais

Atenção: Informamos que não contratamos empresas terceiras que cobrem dos candidatos para a participação em nossos processos. Caso tenha dúvidas, procure nossos canais oficiais ou nossos recrutadores.

O Meio Oficial de Manutenção é responsável por auxiliar na instalação, manutenção e reparo de sistemas de refrigeração, garantindo que os equipamentos operem de forma eficiente e segura. Este profissional desempenha um papel fundamental no suporte às equipes de manutenção, assegurando o correto funcionamento dos sistemas de climatização e refrigeração em edifícios e instalações industriais. Principais Responsabilidades:Auxiliar na instalação de sistemas de refrigeração, incluindo unidades de ar condicionado, refrigeradores e sistemas de climatização, conforme as especificações dos projetos e manuais técnicos. Realizar manutenções preventivas e corretivas em equipamentos de refrigeração, realizando inspeções regulares para identificar problemas e realizar ajustes necessários. Ler e interpretar manuais técnicos, diagramas e esquemas de sistemas de refrigeração para executar as atividades de instalação e manutenção de acordo com as especificações. Realizar testes de desempenho e verificar a eficiência dos sistemas de refrigeração, utilizando equipamentos de medição e ferramentas apropriadas. Manter o ambiente de trabalho seguro e organizado, seguindo as normas de segurança e utilizando os equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs) necessários. Auxiliar na gestão e controle de materiais e ferramentas utilizados na manutenção de sistemas de refrigeração, garantindo seu correto armazenamento e uso. Relatar problemas ou situações anômalas observadas durante as atividades aos profissionais responsáveis para a tomada de medidas corretivas. Colaborar com a equipe de manutenção e seguir as orientações dos técnicos e engenheiros para garantir a execução eficaz das tarefas. Requisitos:Ensino fundamental completo. Experiência prévia em atividades de manutenção de sistemas de refrigeração ou áreas relacionadas (desejável). Conhecimento básico em sistemas de refrigeração e climatização, incluindo componentes e operação dos equipamentos. Habilidade para utilizar ferramentas e instrumentos de medição específicos para sistemas de refrigeração. Conhecimento das normas técnicas e de segurança aplicáveis à manutenção de sistemas de refrigeração.

title: [D] Paid Media Specialist
description:
Paid Media Specialist
Location: Latam

About the Role

We are seeking a User Acquisition Specialist to drive mobile growth through data-driven campaigns and continuous optimization. You will own the planning, execution, and scaling of paid acquisition across Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, App Store Search Ads, and other major mobile ad networks. Success in this role means delivering high-quality users at target CPI and ROAS while collaborating closely with Creative, Data, Lifecycle, and Product teams to ensure alignment with retention and monetization goals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, launch, and optimize paid user acquisition campaigns across Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, App Store Search Ads, and other DSPs.
  • Build and maintain scalable campaign structures including ad sets, audiences, and creative testing strategies focused on acquisition and LTV goals.
  • Develop segmentation and retargeting strategies to support full-funnel growth and re-engagement.
  • Monitor and optimize key performance metrics including CPI, ROAS, CTR, CPM, and install-to-subscription conversion rates.
  • Manage daily budgets, pacing, and bid strategies to maximize ROI within set performance targets.
  • Partner with Creative and Lifecycle Marketing to coordinate A/B testing and optimize creatives, landing pages, and user flows.
  • Produce weekly and monthly reports with actionable insights for leadership and cross-functional teams.
  • Stay current with ad platform policies, algorithms, and best practices to ensure competitive performance.
  • Explore new channels, run experimental tests, and identify emerging growth opportunities.
  • Document campaign learnings and share them across teams.

Requirements

  • Based in Latin America, able to work fully remotely.
  • English: C1 or C2 fluency (written and verbal).
  • 2+ years experience in mobile user acquisition or digital performance marketing.
  • Proven track record managing six-figure monthly ad budgets with ROI targets.
  • Proficiency in Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, and App Store Search Ads.
  • Experience with mobile attribution tools (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch).
  • Strong analytical skills with Excel/Google Sheets and data visualization tools.
  • Deep understanding of mobile marketing metrics (CPI, ROAS, CAC, LTV).
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.
  • Strong ownership mindset with proven collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in gaming, subscription apps, or mobile-first startups.
  • Familiarity with creative briefing and iterative testing cycles.
  • Strong curiosity for emerging trends in mobile growth and ad creative performance.
  • Compensation & Logistics
  • Full-time, remote position for LATAM-based talent.
  • Must have a minimum 4-hour overlap with EST (UTC-5).
  • Success in first 3-6 months: Consistently meets or exceeds UA performance targets, delivers clear reporting and insights, and launches high-impact A/B tests that improve ROI.

Company Overview

Visual Blasters is a fast-growing mobile app and gaming company focused on delivering high-quality, engaging products to millions of users worldwide. We combine creativity, technology, and data to build experiences that delight and retain our audience.

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .
A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.
Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.
O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.
Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Title: Application Modernization Specialist
